_comment: Working example: the Colaberry free-class 15s spot. 450 frames @30fps = 15.000s exactly. Copy this, swap prompts/copy/accents, keep the structure. Durations must sum to a whole number of frames.

meta.title: Free AI Class - 15s vertical
meta._accents_note: Lifted from brand tokens for legibility on dark footage. Brand navy #1a365d / blue #2b6cb0 / green #38a169 are tuned for white backgrounds and go muddy over video.

_style_note: suffix is appended to every prompt so eight generations read as one film. negative is INERT at cfg 1.0 - kept only for the day this runs on a GPU at higher cfg. Do not rely on it.

style.suffix: cinematic editorial photograph, shot on 35mm film, deep navy blue and steel teal color grade, dramatic rim lighting, volumetric atmospheric haze, shallow depth of field, high contrast, premium corporate aesthetic, ultra detailed, sharp focus
style.negative: text, watermark, logo, letters, words, signage, caption, cartoon, anime, illustration, painting, deformed hands, extra fingers, mutated, blurry, low quality, jpeg artifacts, oversaturated, cluttered

_shot_fields.dur: seconds; dur*fps must be a whole number
_shot_fields.motion: zoom_in | zoom_in_slow | zoom_out | pan_left | pan_right - alternate so no two consecutive beats move alike
_shot_fields.anchor: vertical centre of the text block, 0-1. Keep constant (~0.45) across statement beats; only the CTA should differ
_shot_fields.emphasis: the line to colour with the accent - must match a string in lines exactly
_shot_fields.zoom_base: OPTIONAL permanent crop-in to push weak edge detail out of frame
_shot_fields.grade: OPTIONAL per-shot grade overriding the global one - fix weak shots here before paying for a re-generation

shots.prompt: over-the-shoulder view of a lone professional sitting in a dark open-plan office at night, silhouetted against one large softly glowing blank monitor, cold blue screen light on their face, empty desks receding into darkness, isolated and drained

shots._fix_note: First attempt prompted 'fingertips striking a mechanical keyboard'. The model dropped the fingers entirely and covered every keycap in garbled pseudo-lettering (cfg 1.0 = negative prompt inert). Reprompted to express repetition through identical repeating OBJECTS instead of hands and keycaps - no anatomy to mangle, no lettering to garble. Prefer this move over a grade rescue when the subject itself is the problem.
